The repository has two demos: the robot playground (`/`) and the original cube example (`/cube/`). The robot playground now covers everything the cube example shows: it exposes the library's three tools (`three.scene.inspect`, `three.object.update`, `three.renderer.inspect`) in addition to its own robot tools. Keeping the cube example adds pages, build entries, docs and tests to maintain without adding value.

## Expected outcome

- The cube example is removed: its page and build entry, the link to it from the robot playground, and its README section and mentions.
- Browser test coverage of the library's three tools through real WebMCP is kept, using the robot playground instead of the cube page.
- `npm test`, `npm run example:build` and `npm run test:browser` pass.

## Context

- `test/browser/example.spec.mjs` currently opens `/cube/` to exercise the library tools end to end.
- `cube` in `test/library.test.mjs` is only a unit-test fixture name and is unrelated to the example.
- #10 (deploy the demos to GitHub Pages) is being updated to cover only the robot playground.
